subject: Engage platform engineers — webinar invite + RSVP nurture playbook
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: Engage platform engineers webinar — invite + RSVP nurture playbook

Team — attaching the first-pass playbook for the upcoming "Serving LLMs in Production" webinar aimed at platform/ML infra engineers. Goal is to drive high-quality RSVPs (PLG->sales signal) and have a clean nurture that surfaces orgs running >1M tokens/day.

What I need from each of you by EOD Monday:
- Laura: tighten subject lines and A/B copy (2 variants) for HTML invite + 1-line plain text.
- Marcus: define lead scoring & ideal ICP (what signals convert to SDR outreach).
- Jasmine: confirm RSVP page funnel and the HubSpot tracking fields we need.

Key assets attached: invite-copy-v1.html, segment-list-platform-eng.csv.
Proposed send window: Tue 11/10 11:00am PT (primary) / Wed 11/11 5:00am UTC (backup).

High-level nurture cadence (in playbook):
1) Invite (day 0) — send with UTM campaign params; CTA: RSVP
2) Reminder (day 3) — short reminder + speaker highlight (one-click RSVP)
3) Last-chance (day 7) — calendar add + agenda
4) Post-webinar follow-up (day 1) — recording + next steps form

Attachments: invite-copy-v1.html, segment-list-platform-eng.csv

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Growth Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

B) How top infra teams cut inference costs & latency (webinar)

-Laura

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-07T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Engage platform engineers webinar — invite + RSVP nurture playbook

Nice work. For scoring + SDR routing: propose these signals (will add to HubSpot property list):
- Company token volume (from enrichment) > 1M tokens/mo: 30 pts
- Attendee title contains "SRE"/"Platform"/"Infra": 20 pts
- RSVP + attendance: 40 pts
- Company size >100 employees: 10 pts

Thresholds: >=60 pts => SDR outreach within 48 hours; 40-59 pts => automated nurture + AE alert.

Also please add a hidden field on the RSVP form called "partner_source" (values: cloudnative, redwood, acme) so we can map attribution. I'm linking the HubSpot record where we want conversions to land: https://hub.redwood.ai/record/HS-48321

I'll follow up with a short JSON export spec for enrichment.
- Marcus
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
